decisionsTitle: A family sitting reserves every place as its forms are sent, and its one email lists every registration (amending §389, §446, §519 and §536)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-28 11:45**, after registering three people in one sitting on QA: «cumva flow-ul de înscriere în familie tot nu e ok... ar trebui în ultimul mail primit pentru verificare să am toate înscrierile mele! să rezerv 3 locuri și așa să se calculeze pe site». And at 11:50: «trebuie un marker pentru familie... că nu e clar cum rezervăm și pare că nu se salvează corect».

**What was stored before this change.** A PGlite test played his scenario: Ana's form, «Da, încă o persoană», Mihai's form, Ioana's form, then «Nu mai înscriu pe nimeni». After each of the three forms the database held one registration row (Ana, `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION`, no hold) and the others as kept forms (0, then 1, then 2). The public count stayed at 50 of 50 throughout. There was one held outbox row, and the browser's half named the three. The one email did name all three, but the site counted none of them, and a refresh, a second device or the backoffice saw one person. That is the «nu se salvează corect» he saw.

**Decision: every form sent after «Da» is a registration, and reserves its place at once.** From «Da» on, the next form for another person on the same address is no longer a kept form (§446). It writes that person's registration now, in the state a single registration starts in (`PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION`), held with the sitting's one email (§519). The form also reserves the person's place through the allocator's own opening, under the event row's lock: stale holds expired and the waiting list served first, then the one formula. There is no second formula. The press of «Da» that opens the sitting reserves the first form's place, when it takes that registration into the sitting (§536); no later press reserves anything. The reservation is the row's `hold_expires_at` on a `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` row, counted by `countOccupied`, so `readPublicAvailability`, «12 înscriși din 50 de locuri» and the queue panel drop by one with every form. No migration: the column was already there.

**How long a reservation holds.** The club's declaration hold («Termene», 30 minutes by default) counted from the sitting window's end as the last form left it — or the opening press, when no form came after it — capped by the close and the start like every hold. While the family's email is still queued, and was due by that deadline, the reservation holds even past it, because the family has not been told yet. When the email leaves, each reservation still holding moves on by the outbox job's lateness only, never past the club's hold from that send, and is never shortened. Past it, the place is free again. The maintenance job clears the reservation when somebody waits, and the allocator offers the place to the waiting list as it does for any lapsed hold. The registration itself stays, waiting for its address, and is allocated like any other when the address is confirmed. When the address is confirmed while the reservation holds, the place is the person's own, never counted against them.

**A full event.** With no place free, the form reserves nothing, and the person joins the waiting list when the address is confirmed. The screen and the email say so. With the event full and its waiting list closed, the form is refused at the form, as a single registration's is (§348).

**The one email lists every registration.** The family's message now opens with the family marker: «Înscriere de familie: Ana, Mihai și Ioana — 3 locuri rezervate până la 13:44.» (and «o persoană pe lista de așteptare» when there is one), in both halves. Each person's line says their place: «— loc rezervat până la 13:44» or «— pe lista de așteptare, după confirmare». The time is the reservation as it stands after the send. Who the address held at the event before the sitting is listed with their state (confirmat, semnează declarația, pe lista de așteptare, așteaptă confirmarea adresei) and is asked nothing again. That includes a person of the sitting who confirmed from an earlier email of their own. The one button confirms the address and every registration of the sitting, and the §471 wizard signs their declarations one by one. The body says that someone who should not be registered is withdrawn from «Toate înscrierile mele» after confirming, and that the reserved places free themselves if nobody confirms. The family's confirmation page says the places are reserved and nobody is confirmed yet. Only a kept first form (§446) can still be unticked there.

**The screen after each form** reads, from the browser's own half: «Înscriere de familie: Ana, Mihai, Ioana — 3 locuri rezervate până la 13:44.», each name with its place, and one sentence: each place is reserved the moment its form is sent, and the button in the email confirms them all. The half keeps each person's place — reserved, the waiting list, or none where the form wrote no registration (below) — and the reservation's end, a fact about the club's settings and the event.

**The club's limit per address** («Termene», default 4) still counts. When the people this browser sent in the sitting fill it, the next form is refused at the form with its sentence, and nothing is written. Every person it counts was typed on this browser. A limit reached with registrations from elsewhere is still told to the address alone, by its email (§389).

**Another adult's consents** stay theirs (§421). A sitting's row for another adult keeps no health note, socials, public-list tick or fitness statement. The confirmation page asks the address holder's acknowledgement for them, as it did for a kept form.

**A «Familie» marker** names the other people on the same address at the same event, with the family glyph, on every surface that shows a registration. On the backoffice registrations list and on the registration's page it links to each sibling. It is also on the queue panel's new «locuri rezervate de familii» rows, beside the parent's line on the race-day desk (names only, §15.11), on «Înscrierile mele», on the race-day QR page, and in the export's last column, `family`, in the CSV and the spreadsheet. «Înscrierile mele» also says «Loc rezervat până …» for a reserved place, and lists a family in the order the forms were sent. The family's verification message has no club copy (§419); the family's confirmation and its club copy name everybody, as before.

**Unchanged.** A single registration reserves nothing before its address is confirmed. A restart back to `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` now clears whatever hold a cancelled row left in the column, so no stale deadline can count as a reservation. The desk, the test kind (§30: `kind` is in no condition of the reservation) and the sealed cookie's fixed shape (§39) are unchanged. The two-connection concurrency suite is untouched, because a reservation is written only through the allocator it already proves.

**No press moves a reservation (the review of 2026-09-28, round two).** «Da» passes no bot check, and it starts the sitting's window again. In the first round it also lengthened every reservation to the new window's end plus the club's hold, and the email it held back kept each place counted while it was queued. So one form that passed Turnstile, then a press every few minutes, held a place with no inbox proof for as long as the presses went on, and a few addresses could empty a capped race until registration closed: exactly what a single registration is refused. Now a reservation's deadline is written only by a form, which passes the bot check like any registration, and once by the press that opens the sitting, for the first form's place. That press comes within the first form's own window, because the browser's half that carries the first form's seed lives no longer. Every later press reserves nothing and lengthens nothing. Each form of the sitting reserves its own place and moves the sitting's other reservations still holding to the club's window and hold after it. The ceiling is the last form, or the opening press, plus the club's window plus the club's hold: 40 minutes by default.

**A queued email keeps a place only for the outbox job's lateness.** A reservation holds past its stored deadline only while the family's email is queued and was due at or before that deadline. That is the job running late, which the first round's guard was for. A press moves the email's due time with the window, and once the due time is past the deadline the reservation lapses at it, the email still held. When the email leaves, each reservation still holding moves on by the job's lateness (the send's instant less the email's due time), never past the club's hold from the send. An email sent on time lengthens nothing; one sent an hour late (QA's pinger at night) gives the hour back. The email names as reserved only the places this rule still holds. An email the provider's allowance deferred past the deadline (§40) lets its places go too: the registrations stay, and are allocated when the address is confirmed. A PGlite case proves it: one form and a «Da» every five minutes for two hours leave the event back at its capacity from the deadline on.

**A form that wrote no registration names no place.** Inside a sitting a form can still write nothing: the address at the club's limit with registrations made elsewhere (a kept form at the limit, §389), a person the address already holds, or a corrected form whose person holds no place. A «Da» that opens a sitting whose first form was kept (§446) reserves nothing either. In the first round the screen then said the allocator's formula as it stood, «loc rezervat», for a place the public count never took. Now it names neither a reserved place nor the waiting list for that person, and the marker counts only the places reserved and the people waiting. This is a §39 trade-off, named here. The screen after a sitting's form is no longer the same whatever the address holds, because «no place» says this form wrote nothing. It was not the same before either: every reserved place is in the public count, which drops by one for a form that wrote a registration and not for one that did not. Hiding it on the screen protected nothing and cost a false sentence. Before «Da» nothing changes: the first form's screen is the one everybody gets.

**A later press changes no place on the screen.** Because only the opening press reserves, the browser's half takes a place from a press once: the first person's, reserved, on the waiting list, or none. A later press keeps each person's place and the deadline the last form wrote. The screen can no longer keep saying «pe lista de așteptare» for someone a press gave a place, as the review found it could.

**Refused.** Reserving a single registration's place at its form: it would change §10.6's count for everybody, and one form could then hold a place for 48 hours without an inbox. A new message type for a lapsed reservation, or a reminder before it lapses that names whose place it is: the place returns silently, as a lapsed declaration hold's does, and the family's email already says the reserved places free themselves. A press that lengthens a reservation, even by a little: whatever a press may move, presses repeated move it without bound.
changelogLine: - **A family's places are reserved as its forms are sent** — after «Da, încă o persoană» each form writes that person's registration with a held place, so the site counts three places for three people at once, for the club's window and hold after the last form (pressing «Da» again never stretches it); the one email lists everybody with «loc rezervat» or «pe lista de așteptare», one button confirms them all, and a «Familie» marker names the others on every surface that shows a registration. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Every form a family sitting sends after «Da, încă o persoană» writes that person's registration at once, `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` with a place reserved through the allocator under the event's lock, so the public count drops by one per form: three people leave 47 of 50 places free before any address is confirmed, and the confirmation gives each their own place without counting it twice; a single registration still holds no place before its address is confirmed (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A family's reservation lasts the club's window and declaration hold after the last form of its sitting, or after the press that opened it; a later «Da» press reserves and lengthens nothing, a queued email keeps it past that deadline only when the email was due by it, and the send moves it on only by the outbox job's lateness, so one form and a «Da» every five minutes for two hours leave the event back at its capacity from the deadline on; past it, the maintenance job clears the reservation when somebody waits and the waiting list is offered the place; with no place free the form reserves nothing and its person joins the waiting list at the confirmation, and with the event full and its line closed the form is refused as a single one is (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The family's one email opens with «Înscriere de familie: Ana, Mihai și Ioana — 3 locuri rezervate până la HH:MM.», names every person of the sitting with their place («loc rezervat» or «pe lista de așteptare, după confirmare») and who the address held before with their state, and its single-use link confirms all of them in one press and opens the declaration wizard for each (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The sitting's screen after each form says «Înscriere de familie: Ana, Mihai, Ioana — 3 locuri rezervate până la HH:MM.» with each name's place, from the browser's own half; a person whose form wrote no registration (a kept form at the address's limit, a person the address already holds) is shown with no place, neither reserved nor waiting; a form whose sitting already fills the club's limit per address is refused at the form with its sentence and writes nothing (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The backoffice registrations list and page, the queue panel, the race-day desk and the export's last column `family` name the other people on the same address at the same event; on the list and the page each name links to that registration, and the desk shows names only (2026-09-28, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a family sitting reserves every place as its forms are sent, and its one email lists everybody
